_pools: Small on purpose: one page of names a reader can check. Every one reads as either gender, in
Spanish and in English, and that is deliberate — picking a replacement by gender would mean
inferring the gender of a real person from their name, and a wrong guess writes 'her son Marta'
into a clinical note. A lineage of your own is not checked for this: it is the author's call.
_generalizations: What a kind becomes when it is widened rather than removed. A postal code is NOT here, and is
skipped if a lineage puts it here: Safe Harbor keeps its first three digits only where the 2020
census counts more than 20,000 people behind them, and that table is compiled into the build.
